name: zdeclient_crater_init_event_template_defaults
description: zDEClient_Crater::InitEventTemplateDefaults copies the current global crater event-template defaults into the caller-provided template.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zDEClient crater source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x456b00 validates copying ten DWORDs, the full 0x28-byte zDEClient_CraterEventTemplate, from g_zDEClient_CraterEventTemplateDefaults into the caller-provided ECX pointer.
The native smoke verifies every field in the copied crater event template, including flags, point count, material pointer, slope/depth/radius, center vector, and damage-owner pointer.
